tools.name: OrcaSlicer
tools.description: Feature-rich open-source slicer with profiles for most brands and built-in calibration tests (flow, PA, temp towers).

tools.name: PrusaSlicer
tools.description: Prusa's mature open-source slicer: organic supports, variable layer height, SVG/text emboss, good third-party profiles.

tools.name: Bambu Studio
tools.description: Bambu Lab's slicer with multi-plate projects, AMS color painting and direct printer connection.

tools.name: UltiMaker Cura
tools.description: Long-standing slicer with a huge plugin marketplace and hundreds of fine-grained settings.

tools.name: ElegooSlicer
tools.description: Orca-based slicer tuned for Elegoo FDM printers like the Centauri Carbon.

tools.name: SuperSlicer
tools.description: PrusaSlicer fork with extra knobs and calibration menus for tinkerers.

tools.name: Lychee Slicer
tools.description: Popular resin slicer with smart auto-supports, hollowing and island detection.

tools.name: CHITUBOX
tools.description: Widely supported resin slicer for MSLA printers, with a Pro tier for advanced supports.

tools.name: Kiri:Moto
tools.description: Open-source slicer that runs entirely in the browser — FDM, SLA, CNC and laser. Handy on Chromebooks or locked-down PCs.

tools.name: Unlayered Slicer
tools.description: OrcaSlicer fork that adds non-planar slicing on normal 3-axis printers, wave overhangs and 5-axis support. Free beta; Bambu wireless printing not yet supported.

tools.name: Tinkercad
tools.description: Drag-and-drop CAD in the browser — the easiest start for simple functional parts and beginners.

tools.name: Onshape
tools.description: Full parametric CAD in the browser. Free plan for hobbyists, documents are public.

tools.name: Fusion
tools.description: Autodesk's parametric CAD/CAM; free for personal, non-commercial use with some limits.

tools.name: FreeCAD
tools.description: Open-source parametric CAD; version 1.x fixed the topological naming problem and made it much more usable.

tools.name: Shapr3D
tools.description: Touch- and pencil-friendly direct modelling on iPad, Mac and Windows.

tools.name: OpenSCAD
tools.description: Model with code — the language behind most online customizers and generators.

tools.name: build123d
tools.description: Python code-CAD on the OpenCascade kernel — real B-rep, fillets and STEP export, great for parametric parts.

tools.name: CadQuery
tools.description: Python code-CAD with a fluent API, also on OpenCascade.

tools.name: ExportToPython
tools.description: Fusion add-in that converts a Fusion design into build123d Python code — bridge from GUI modelling to parametric code.

tools.name: OCP CAD Viewer (VS Code)
tools.description: The standard live 3D viewer for build123d/CadQuery inside VS Code — show(), measure, explode, clip planes.

tools.name: Yet Another CAD Viewer
tools.description: Browser-based viewer for build123d/OCP models; share models as a static web page.

tools.name: CQ-editor (build123d fork)
tools.description: Standalone code editor with 3D preview and object tree, adapted for build123d.

tools.name: OCP.wasm
tools.description: Runs build123d's OpenCascade stack in the browser via WebAssembly — basis for web-based parametric generators.

tools.name: partomatic
tools.description: Framework for standardized parametric build123d models with config files and a web interface to generate variants.

tools.name: PartCAD
tools.description: Package manager for CAD: version, share and reuse build123d/CadQuery/OpenSCAD parts across projects.

tools.name: blendquery
tools.description: Run build123d/CadQuery scripts inside Blender and keep them parametric there.

tools.name: Blender
tools.description: Sculpting and organic modelling for figures and art pieces; ships a 3D-Print Toolbox add-on.

tools.name: Printables
tools.description: Prusa's model library with good tagging, remixes, print profiles and contests.

tools.name: MakerWorld
tools.description: Bambu Lab's library with ready-to-print 3MF profiles and in-browser parametric customizers.

tools.name: Thingiverse
tools.description: The oldest large model archive — huge back catalogue, including many OpenSCAD customizers.

tools.name: Thangs
tools.description: Model search across sites, including geometric search by uploading a similar shape.

tools.name: Cults3D
tools.description: Marketplace for free and paid designs, strong on miniatures and decor.

tools.name: Yeggi
tools.description: Search engine that indexes printable models across most repositories.

tools.name: Bento3D
tools.description: Design partitioned trays and matching hinged boxes to the millimeter, with a live 3D preview and STL export.

tools.name: PrintPal Bin Generator
tools.description: Sorting trays and drawer bins with a rows × columns grid, wall/floor thickness and corner radius.

tools.name: MakerWorld Parametric Model Maker
tools.description: Runs OpenSCAD models in the browser. Thousands of community generators for boxes, enclosures, trays, gears and name tags.

tools.name: openGrid Tile Generator
tools.description: Generates openGrid wall/desk panels in any size for the open-source openGrid mounting system — the board everything else clips onto.

tools.name: Parametric Multiboard Generator
tools.description: Multiboard wall tiles sized to your wall and bed, generated in MakerWorld's customizer.

tools.name: Multiconnect Hook Generator
tools.description: Custom hooks and holders with the Multiconnect back for Multiboard and openGrid.

tools.name: Perplexing Labs Gridfinity Generator
tools.description: The most complete Gridfinity web UI: bins, baseplates, lids and rugged boxes, backed by Gridfinity Rebuilt and Extended.

tools.name: Gridfinity Bin Generator (Bouwens)
tools.description: CadQuery-based bin and baseplate generator — exports STEP as well as STL, so you can keep editing.

tools.name: Gridfinity Layout Tool
tools.description: Plan a whole drawer and generate bins and baseplates in the browser; works offline once loaded.

tools.name: Tooltrace
tools.description: Photograph tools on an A4/Letter sheet; AI traces the outlines and builds a Gridfinity insert or shadow-box foam layout.

tools.name: GridFlock
tools.description: Splits large Gridfinity baseplates into puzzle-locking pieces that fit small print beds.

tools.name: QRcode2stl
tools.description: QR codes for URLs, Wi-Fi, vCards and Spotify codes as printable tags, with optional text and keychain hole.

tools.name: 3D Print QR Code
tools.description: Client-side QR tag generator with separate base/code heights, labels, icons and rounded corners.

tools.name: MakerWorld Image to Keychain
tools.description: Turns a logo or picture into a multi-color keychain ready for Bambu Studio.

tools.name: HueForge
tools.description: Filament painting: turns images into layered multi-color reliefs using filament transmission values, printable with one nozzle and color swaps.

tools.name: ItsLitho
tools.description: Feature-rich lithophane maker: flat, curved, lamps, night lights and globes, with a built-in image editor.

tools.name: 3DP.Rocks Lithophane
tools.description: Fast, minimal lithophane generator with gamma/thickness controls and backlit preview.

tools.name: Lithophane Maker
tools.description: Lots of lithophane shapes — lamps, ceiling-fan covers, night lights, ornaments.

tools.name: Cookiecad Designer
tools.description: Trace an image into cookie cutters, stamps, embossers, stencils or cake toppers, with a PDF size check.

tools.name: MakerWorld MakerLab
tools.description: Bambu's playground of free generators: PrintMon (AI figures), lithophanes, lanterns, pixel puzzles, keychains and more — printer-agnostic exports.

tools.name: Terrain2STL
tools.description: Draw a box on a world map and download the terrain as an STL. Global coverage.

tools.name: TouchTerrain
tools.description: Research-grade terrain models from elevation data, with tiling for prints bigger than your bed.

tools.name: CADMAPPER
tools.description: City blocks with buildings from OpenStreetMap — free up to 1 km². Exports CAD formats you convert before slicing.

tools.name: OpenSCAD Playground
tools.description: OpenSCAD in the browser with Customizer UI: paste any .scad generator, tweak sliders, export multi-color 3MF.

tools.name: Gear Generator
tools.description: Lay out involute spur gear trains and planetaries visually, check ratios, export the profile.

tools.name: YAPP Box
tools.description: Yet Another Parametric Projectbox: PCB enclosures with cutouts, standoffs and snap lids. Works in OpenSCAD Playground.

tools.name: BOSL2
tools.description: The big OpenSCAD standard library: involute gears and racks, threads, hinges, snap/dovetail joiners, bottle caps, rounding and attachments.

tools.name: threadlib
tools.description: OpenSCAD library for standard threads (metric, UNC/UNF, pipe threads) with clean, printable geometry.

tools.name: threads.scad
tools.description: Lightweight OpenSCAD threads: bolts, nuts, threaded holes and rods with adjustable tolerance.

tools.name: NopSCADlib
tools.description: Huge OpenSCAD library of real-world 'vitamins' (screws, bearings, motors, PCBs, extrusions) plus printed parts and assembly views.

tools.name: bd_warehouse
tools.description: build123d parts library: ISO fasteners, threads, bearings, flanges, pipes and sprockets as real B-rep solids.

tools.name: py_gearworks
tools.description: Python gear framework on build123d: spur, helical, bevel and more, with proper meshing setups.

tools.name: bd_vslot
tools.description: V-slot aluminium extrusion components for build123d — handy for printer frames and jigs.

tools.name: bd_beams_and_bars
tools.description: build123d library of standard steel sections and bars (UPN, IPN, flat, round…) as 2D profiles and 3D beams.

tools.name: dl4to4ocp
tools.description: Topology optimization for build123d/OCP models — lets material follow the load path before printing.

tools.name: ocp-freecad-cam
tools.description: Generate CNC toolpaths from build123d/CadQuery models using FreeCAD's CAM engine.

tools.name: Fusion 360 FDM Threads
tools.description: Custom trapezoidal thread profiles for Fusion with built-in clearance classes (e.g. 0.1e bolt + 0.1i nut) that actually print well.

tools.name: FreeCAD Fasteners Workbench
tools.description: Adds standard screws, nuts, washers and heat-set-insert holes to FreeCAD models, snapped to holes.

tools.name: KiCad StepUp
tools.description: Round-trips PCBs between KiCad and FreeCAD so enclosures fit the real board, connectors and mounting holes.

tools.name: 3DPrintCalcs Mechanical
tools.description: Browser calculators for printed mechanics, including cantilever snap-fit dimensions.

tools.name: Parametric Vacuum Adapter Generator
tools.description: Hose and vacuum adapters between any two diameters for workshop dust extraction, from a form.

tools.name: McMaster-Carr
tools.description: Free, accurate CAD models (STEP) of almost every screw, bearing, spring and profile — drop them into your design to check fits.

tools.name: GrabCAD Library
tools.description: Millions of community CAD models — motors, sensors, dev boards — to design mounts and housings around.

tools.name: Meshy
tools.description: Text- and image-to-3D with remeshing and repair. Free tier is limited and non-commercial.

tools.name: Tripo
tools.description: Image- and text-to-3D with good topology and segmentation. Monthly free credits.

tools.name: Zoo Design Studio
tools.description: Text-to-CAD and code-CAD (KCL) that outputs real B-rep geometry instead of meshes.

tools.name: KIRI Engine
tools.description: Phone photogrammetry, LiDAR and Gaussian-splat scanning with mesh export.

tools.name: RealityScan
tools.description: Epic's photogrammetry app and desktop tool, now free to use for most makers.

tools.name: Polycam
tools.description: LiDAR and photo scanning on phones; quick room and object captures.

tools.name: Meshroom
tools.description: Open-source photogrammetry pipeline (AliceVision) for desktop; needs a CUDA GPU for best results.

tools.name: Formware Online STL Repair
tools.description: Upload a broken STL, get it back watertight: holes, flipped normals, non-manifold edges.

tools.name: iamRapid STL Repair
tools.description: Diagnoses and repairs STL/OBJ meshes locally in the browser — nothing gets uploaded.

tools.name: Online 3D Viewer
tools.description: Open-source viewer for STL, 3MF, OBJ, STEP and more, right in the browser — quick look and measure without installing anything.

tools.name: ImageToStl
tools.description: Browser converters between almost any 3D and image format: SVG/PNG to STL, STEP/OBJ/3MF/GLB to STL and back.

tools.name: MeshLab
tools.description: Swiss-army knife for meshes: cleanup, decimation, remeshing, measuring scans.

tools.name: Meshmixer
tools.description: Classic for hollowing, cutting, tree supports and sculpt fixes. No longer developed, but still downloadable.

tools.name: MeshInspector
tools.description: Free in-browser repair tools without sign-up (fill holes, flip normals, fix tunnels, simplify); automatic healing and a desktop app for big scans are paid.

tools.name: CloudCompare
tools.description: Open-source point cloud and mesh processing: align scans, compare a print against its CAD (deviation color maps), clean and mesh point clouds.

tools.name: Instant Meshes
tools.description: Turns messy scan triangles into clean, evenly spaced quad/tri meshes in seconds — great before editing or converting a scan.

tools.name: FreeCAD Reverse Engineering Workbench
tools.description: Free scan-to-CAD toolkit in FreeCAD: fit planes, cylinders and B-spline surfaces to meshes or point clouds, then model on top. Closest free thing to Geomagic Design X.

tools.name: Detessellate
tools.description: FreeCAD macro workbench for turning STL/3MF meshes back into editable solids: align, mesh-to-body, auto-generate and clean coplanar sketches, then finish in PartDesign.

tools.name: BumpMesh
tools.description: CNC Kitchen's texture tool: bakes real displacement textures (knurl, leather, wood…) onto STL/3MF/STEP models — a better fuzzy skin. Runs locally in the browser.

tools.name: ScanRuler
tools.description: CNC Kitchen's scan analysis tool: fit spheres, cylinders and planes to a 3D scan, measure it, map deviation from CAD and check wall thickness. Runs locally in the browser.

tools.name: Klipper
tools.description: Firmware that moves the motion planning to a Raspberry Pi; input shaping, pressure advance, macros.

tools.name: Mainsail
tools.description: Lightweight web interface for Klipper/Moonraker with G-code viewer and timelapse support.

tools.name: Fluidd
tools.description: Alternative Klipper web UI with a clean dashboard and Spoolman integration.

tools.name: OctoPrint
tools.description: The classic web host for Marlin printers, with hundreds of plugins.

tools.name: Marlin
tools.description: Most common open-source firmware for hobby FDM printers.

tools.name: Obico
tools.description: AI spaghetti detection and remote access for OctoPrint, Klipper and Bambu; server can be self-hosted.

tools.name: SimplyPrint
tools.description: Cloud print management for single printers to farms: queue, cloud slicing, AI detection, user management.

tools.name: OctoEverywhere
tools.description: Secure remote access, notifications and AI detection for OctoPrint, Klipper and Bambu printers.

tools.name: Prusa Connect
tools.description: Prusa's free cloud dashboard for monitoring, queues and file transfer across Prusa printers.

tools.name: Open Bambu Networking
tools.description: Open-source drop-in replacement for Bambu Studio's closed networking plugin. LAN-first: discovery, printing, file transfer and camera; also works with OrcaSlicer 2.3.2+.

tools.name: Bambuddy
tools.description: Self-hosted print management for Bambu printers without Bambu Cloud: live monitoring, queue and scheduling, archive, fleet dispatch by loaded filament, optional headless Orca/Bambu Studio slicing. Live demo at demo.bambuddy.cool.

tools.name: PrintBuddy
tools.description: One self-hosted dashboard for mixed fleets — Bambu, Klipper/Moonraker and PrusaLink — with filament tracking and print history. Early development, not production-ready yet.

tools.name: Printago
tools.description: Cloud print-farm software built around Bambu printers (others too): automatic queue dispatch, slicing in the cloud, SKU-based order workflows for shops — no Raspberry Pi needed.

tools.name: Mobileraker
tools.description: Polished phone app for Klipper/Moonraker printers with push notifications, webcam and multi-printer support.

tools.name: KlipperScreen
tools.description: Touchscreen UI for Klipper on a small HDMI/DSI display attached to the Pi.

tools.name: Home Assistant Bambu Lab
tools.description: Brings Bambu printers into Home Assistant: status, AMS, camera, automations like switching off the enclosure fan or light after a print.

tools.name: Spoolman
tools.description: Self-hosted spool inventory that tracks remaining filament per spool and syncs usage from Klipper/Moonraker and OctoPrint.

tools.name: FilaMan
tools.description: ESP32 + NFC + load cell filament manager: weighs spools, reads/writes NFC tags and syncs with Spoolman and Bambu printers.

tools.name: SpoolmanScale
tools.description: DIY touchscreen spool scale (ESP32-S3, PN532 NFC, NAU7802) that shows remaining filament and syncs with Spoolman, FilaMan or BamBuddy. Around €50–60 in parts.

tools.name: Open Filament Database
tools.description: Community-maintained, MIT-licensed database of filament brands, products and stores with a public API — a neutral data source for apps and spool managers.

tools.name: SpoolmanDB
tools.description: Open filament catalog (brand, material, color, density, spool weight) that Spoolman uses to prefill new spools.

tools.name: 3D Filament Profiles
tools.description: Searchable filament catalog with community print settings, colors and spool data, plus personal inventory tracking.

tools.name: FilamentColors.xyz
tools.description: Library of real, photographed filament swatches with color matching — find which filament actually matches a target color.

tools.name: Prusa Material Guide
tools.description: Per-material cheat sheets: temperatures, bed surface, strengths, drying and safety notes.

tools.name: Omni 3D Printing Cost Calculator
tools.description: Quick estimate of filament, electricity and machine cost per print.

tools.name: Teaching Tech Calibration
tools.description: Step-by-step calibration with generated test G-code: first layer, flow, retraction, temperature, acceleration, linear advance.

tools.name: Ellis' Print Tuning Guide
tools.description: Deep-dive tuning reference (pressure advance, extrusion multiplier, input shaping). Orca's built-in tests follow it.

tools.name: OrcaSlicer Calibration Wiki
tools.description: How to use Orca's built-in temperature, flow, pressure advance, retraction and max-flow tests.

tools.name: Klippain Shake&Tune
tools.description: Klipper module that turns accelerometer data into readable graphs for input shaping, belt tension comparison and frame resonances.

tools.name: FullControl
tools.description: Generate G-code directly from parametric designs — vases, lattices, test prints — without a slicer or CAD.

tools.name: gCodeViewer
tools.description: Inspect G-code layer by layer locally in the browser, with print statistics.

tools.name: Craftcloud
tools.description: Upload a file, compare prices and lead times from dozens of print services worldwide (FDM, SLS, MJF, resin, metal, CNC).

tools.name: JLC3DP
tools.description: Low-cost industrial printing (SLA, MJF, SLS, metal) from the JLCPCB group — handy to add parts to a PCB order.

tools.name: Simplify3D Print Quality Guide
tools.description: Photo-based troubleshooting: find the picture that looks like your failed print, get causes and fixes.

tools.name: Prusa Knowledge Base
tools.description: Extensive, well-illustrated articles on print quality, materials and maintenance — useful beyond Prusa printers.

tools.name: CNC Kitchen
tools.description: Data-driven tests of part strength, infill, annealing, inserts and materials.

tools.name: All3DP
tools.description: Large magazine with guides, software round-ups and printer reviews.

tools.name: r/3Dprinting
tools.description: Big, active community for help with failed prints and printer questions.

tools.name: SolidCraft CAD
tools.description: Guide to SolidCraft, an open-source parametric CAD app written in Rust: running it in the browser or on desktop, setting up its MCP server, and exporting STL or 3MF for printing.

tools.name: printer.tools
tools.description: Broad directory of 3D printing tools, guides and calculators.

tools.name: gridfinity.xyz
tools.description: Community hub for the Gridfinity system with links to generators, specs and layout tools.
